text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing. Silence 
Suzuka suddenly stopped in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No, um...
At the end of her gaze stood an arcade.

Inside the claw machine at the storefront, 
snow globes were lined up as prizes.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I was just thinking how beautiful it 
is.
choice_data_list: If you're curious, let's go check it out.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um... are you sure it's okay?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Then... yes, please. A slight detour, 
right?

Once inside the store, they decided to try 
out the crane game right away, but—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... you press this button, right? And 
then the crane moves—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm perfectly fine. Please don't 
worry.
—Or so Silence Suzuka said, but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? T-That's not where I wanted you to 
go—

The claw operated by Silence Suzuka didn't 
even graze the prize snow globe.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Um, well...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Could I go exchange some money? Just a 
little more...
choice_data_list: Do you really want it that badly?
Do you really want it that badly?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. A snowy landscape inside a tiny 
miniature garden—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I thought it would look wonderful if you 
had this in your room.
choice_data_list: Can I try doing it instead?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I thought it would look wonderful if you 
had this in your room.
choice_data_list: Can I try doing it instead?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much. Without fail—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, right... Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, could you give me some 
advice? Just like during the races...

I gave crane game advice to Silence 
Suzuka, who was burning with motivation.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... let's start carefully from the 
front.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Next, let's look from the side—ah.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I-It fell off... But let's try one more 
time—

Continuing with that approach over several 
attempts, finally—
(CLUNK!)

The crane Silence Suzuka was controlling 
dropped the snow globe!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
A beautiful snowy landscape—I finally 
caught it.

Holding the snow globe in her arms, 
Silence Suzuka remained in high spirits 
all the way home.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "...Wait, Trainer, did you want one too?"
choice_data_list: If I get it, I'll give it to Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "Huh...? Really? Yes, please...!"

And so, I took up the claw machine 
challenge on Silence Suzuka's behalf—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Carefully, very carefully—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah, it lifted...!
(CLUNK!)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it actually came off...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, is it really alright for me to have 
this?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you ask for it back later... 
well, it'd be a bit troublesome, but—"
choice_data_list: I got this to give to Suzuka

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: To me...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I wonder where in my 
room I should display it...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Once it's decided— Trainer, you'll be the 
first one I tell.

Clutching the snow globe, we head home. 
Silence Suzuka seems genuinely pleased 
with it.
